models.observations: A pale oval hull sits above two plain tapered docking supports. At 64 pixels its blue rim and white upper surface read as a canopy; the nose and tiny fins do little to convey a passenger airship.  Checked the 771/490/209 triangle LOD chain and 2 age previews.
defects: Give the seedship a visible passenger gondola or band of windows, and a distinct tail or mooring mast, so the ship and docking structure read separately at phone size.

models.observations: The round vault annex has a recessed outline around a gold cross-shaped wheel. The wheel is too small and blends into an otherwise blank curved facade at phone size, reading as an emblem rather than a vault.  Checked the 864/525/215 triangle LOD chain and 2 age previews.
defects: Frame a visible vault door on the annex with a central hub, a larger readable wheel and offset hinge or lock blocks, keeping the separate front entrance clear.
